high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a bathroom or dressing area. The individual is standing against a plain white wall with a door partially visible on the left side of the frame. The floor is tiled with light-colored tiles. The person is wearing a green button-up shirt that is slightly unbuttoned at the collar, revealing a bit of chest hair. They have dark, curly hair styled upwards. They are also wearing dark blue jeans and white sneakers with beige laces. On their left wrist, they have a black watch. A silver chain necklace is visible around their neck.
